method: # IMPERIA CW — Cold War: sourced January 1970 uranium district audit.
Surveyed means a district or prospect was identified before 1 January 1970; production beginning later does not invalidate a known prospect.
All initial raw uranium production and built uranium mine levels remain zero. These records only permit paid development; this audit does not modify runtime files.
Mine slots and output per level are explicit gameplay capacity bands, not reconstructed 1970 reserve tonnages, modern resource totals or historical output.
known_by_year is a conservative documented upper bound; it may represent the end of a documented exploration period rather than an exact discovery year.
Historical districts closed or largely depleted by 1970 receive only minimal alternative redevelopment capacity and are labelled accordingly.
State identifiers were reconciled with current history/states files. Broad regional assignments and uncertain cases are disclosed in notes; modern political boundaries do not control the map.
Primary and authoritative sources include operator archives, national geological surveys, regulators, IAEA/NEA country contributions and national-laboratory reports.
Later discoveries sharing an allowed state are exclusions from initial capacity justification, not exclusions of the entire state.
Register contains 57 surveyed districts: the prior 52 minus Nebraska, plus South Australia, Northwestern Territories, Minas Gerais, Noroeste, Cordoba and southeastern Kazakhstan.

districts: Northern Kazakh / Kokchetav uranium province: Aksu-Stepnogorsk and early related deposits
deposits.note: Small gameplay capacity for the established northern Kazakh uranium province, with Stepnogorsk development beginning in 1956. Local map inspection places the Aksu-Stepnogorsk area in province 10633 and Kokchetav near province 12619, both state 714. The prior state 716 allocation was moved, not duplicated. No later Semizbay reserve is included.

state_mapping_corrections.method: Approximate geographical interpolation using local labelled VP province centroids and map/provinces.bmp, followed by actual state province-membership lookup. Both the Stepnogorsk/Aksu area and Kokchetav fall north of the state 716 boundary.
